{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] g0, l0;
    wire [7:0] g1, l1;
    wire [3:0] g2, l2;
    wire [1:0] g3, l3;

    assign g0 = A & ~B;
    assign l0 = B & ~A;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : compare_pairs
            assign g1[i] = g0[2*i+1] | (~l0[2*i+1] & g0[2*i]);
            assign l1[i] = l0[2*i+1] | (~g0[2*i+1] & l0[2*i]);
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin : compare_quads
            assign g2[i] = g1[2*i+1] | (~l1[2*i+1] & g1[2*i]);
            assign l2[i] = l1[2*i+1] | (~g1[2*i+1] & l1[2*i]);
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 2; i = i + 1) begin : compare_octets
            assign g3[i] = g2[2*i+1] | (~l2[2*i+1] & g2[2*i]);
            assign l3[i] = l2[2*i+1] | (~g2[2*i+1] & l2[2*i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign gt = g3[1] | (~l3[1] & g3[0]);
    assign lt = l3[1] | (~g3[1] & l3[0]);
    assign eq = ~(g3[1] | l3[1] | g3[0] | l3[0]);
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The unsigned magnitude outputs require information from potentially every bit. A long comparison chain can dominate mapped maximum arrival time.",
  "rewrite": "Use a balanced, four-level dual-rail comparison tree. Each subtree computes greater-than and less-than flags. A parent uses G = G_high | (~L_high & G_low) and L = L_high | (~G_high & L_low), avoiding a separate equality-propagation tree. Equality is decoded directly from the two octet comparisons rather than waiting for the final magnitude outputs.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit balanced structure limits comparison propagation to four merge levels and exposes compact AND/OR/invert mapping opportunities. A timing improvement is expected if the baseline maps to a deeper comparison network; the actual gain requires the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing dual-rail subtree results avoids separate equality and magnitude networks. The structure targets the supplied area cap, but mapped area, buffering overhead, and zero slew/capacitance violations require verification in the evaluation flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Exact combinational unsigned 16-bit comparison for all binary A and B values. The merge identities hold because each subtree's greater-than and less-than flags are mutually exclusive. Equality holds exactly when neither octet is greater nor less. Module name, port names, widths, and unsigned declarations are preserved; there are no parameters, state elements, assumptions, or external dependencies."
